findings.credit_order: A bare85 ->11 data change is insufficient. Spell::DoSpellHitOnUnit dispatches effects in index order:205040 first teleports252, then awards90. A normal NPC cast finishes outside Player::Update's private can-delay-teleport scope. Player::TeleportTo can therefore remove the target from the old map immediately, before effect90 calls RewardPlayerAndGroupAtEvent; that helper rejects an out-of-world player/source. The regression reproduces this lost-credit ordering with the actual far-teleport deferral branch and actual credit/group bodies. No broken intermediate data-only caster change was deployed.

Native group eligibility must be retained, not silently replaced with direct personal KilledMonsterCredit.

This proves accepted-transfer ordering, NOT successful arrival/ACK; a later disconnect/arrival failure and full native saved-counter integration remain separate checks.
